integrity: The theorem is proved by explicit carry and linear-span identities; the included finite enumeration is corroboration only. The general symbol-pair generation-profile framework is credited to Singh–Singh (2026).
limitations: Binary first-order Reed–Muller codes, binary numerical coordinate order and cyclic symbol-pair metric only. No arbitrary-order or higher-order extension, no optimal redundancy theorem, and no independent priority certification.
title: Flat symbol-pair spectrum and logarithmic connectivity ladder of \(\mathrm{RM}(1,m)\)
